text:
deploybot: automated monitor detected embeddings-cost anomaly in us-east-2 during change window; scheduled auto-revert to image v4.1.0 in 12m if not acknowledged. :warning:

nina: seeing cost ratio ~2.4x for embed-heavy tenants. no error-rate increase. can we scope?

marco: only /v1/embeddings with model rwd-embed-xsmall changed config: dynamic_batch=true and new matmul kernel. suspect dynamic batching behavior for tiny inputs.

ops-chi: auto-revert timer at 9m. options: full image revert, config toggle on canary, or traffic-slice affected tenants to fallback.

sre-tess: i'd like a canary probe first. flip dynamic_batch=false on one canary pool and observe embed_cost_per_1k_tokens and p95 latency for 4m.

pm-ravi: PMs prefer targeted mitigation to avoid broad churn, but want pin if we touch runtime to keep notes consistent. billing-bot: loop for tenant comms if we touch billing.

nina: request hold auto-revert for 15m to run canary. suppressing now. reason=canary_probe_by_engineering

deploybot: hold acknowledged, suppression applied for 15m.

(4m later)

marco: canary rollback of dynamic_batch applied: dynamic_batch=false on canary-eu. cost dropped ~68% on canary, latency unchanged.

ops-chi: propose progressive config rollout: 10% steps every 2m, set a temporary pin to v4.0.9 for 8h to avoid another flip during mitigation. will re-enable auto-revert if thresholds persist.

sre-tess: monitoring set. new oncall rule: if embed_cost_p90 > 1.6x baseline for 10m AND affected_tenants > 3 -> post in eng-releases with tag rollback_exec to initiate full revert to v4.0.8.

pm-ravi: approve pin + release note update. release-note snippet: "temporary disable of dynamic batching for embeddings in us-east-2 and pinned runtime to v4.0.9 to mitigate transient cost increase."

billing-bot: ready for tenant list; will prep billing-friendly wording once PMs share impacted IDs.

ops-chi: executing progressive rollout and pin now:
```bash
rdwctl rollout config us-east-2 --set dynamic_batch=false --steps 10 --interval 120s
rdwctl pin set service:embeddings us-east-2 --version 4.0.9 --duration 8h --reason "cost mitigation"
```

marco: started staged rollout at 10%. will report at 30% and 70% gates.

sre-tess: at 30% cost region-wide down ~45%, no error regressions. hold proceeding if anything spikes.

nina: thanks all, nice targeted save. i'll file follow-up to add tiny-input dynamic-batch test to canary suite and update the changelog. :thumbsup:

deploybot: suppression will expire when pin duration ends. auto-revert unsuppressed after expiry. thread closed unless new alerts appear.
